capabilities: Crop vault images in a modal canvas with aspect ratio presets (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, freeform)
Resize images inline in the note editor with interactive handles
Replace the source vault file or save the edited image as a new asset
Support PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF formats
extras: Noted as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT. Styling is designed to match the Zenith theme and the Project Mantle workspace. Troubleshooting covers read-only mode, unsupported formats (SVG, PDF), and attachment folder configuration.
problem: Editing images normally requires leaving Obsidian for an external editor; this plugin lets you crop and resize images directly from notes.
summary: Image editor that crops and resizes vault images inside Obsidian, replacing the file or saving the result as a new asset.
